description: SQLite is a small SQL database that can run inside an app. This site uses SQLite for its SQL playground. Learn tables, filters, joins and safe sample changes with examples that run right in the browser. Use the SQL Run button for examples marked runnable. They use this site's in-browser SQLite database and sample-only table names. A Python example needs Python on your own computer instead.
versionNote: Uses SQLite 3 core features supported by the bundled sql.js engine.
